title: Merger.
bodyText: The general corporation laws relating to the merger of domestic corporations shall apply to associations formed under this chapter.
bodyHtml: §421C-31  Merger.  The general corporation laws relating to the merger of domestic corporations shall apply to associations formed under this chapter. [L 1982, c 97, pt of §2; am L 1986, c 339, §73; am L 2004, c 121, §27]
